    "required": true
   },
   {
    "name": "domains",
    "type": "array",
    "description": "An array of strings, each string is a domain to be added to the policy.",
    "required": true
   }
  ],
  "returns": [
   {
    "name": "policy_id",
    "type": "string",
    "description": "The unique identifier of the created policy."
   }
  ],
